profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Goldman Sachs

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Analyst - Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Developed and implemented functionalities in an AWS cloud infrastructure based application utilizing ECS, S3, Lambda,
SQS, SNS and DynamoDB to improve system scalability and reliability, that was directly integrated with managed GitLab.
● Managed and Improvised CloudFormation templates used for auto-deploy of AWS resources through Infrastructure-as-Code
(IaC) by working on metadata, resource deployment configs and data retention to increase operational efficiency.
● Assisted team members to conduct cost analysis on AWS infrastructure billings & implement cost optimization measures.
● Implemented Service-Level-Objectives (SLOs) & Service-Level-Indicators (SLIs) for reliability by utilizing metrics data from
services and integrating with Prometheus, Alert manager, in-house incident response platforms and Grafana.

positions.title: Software Project Manager
positions.description:
Strong technical background with expertise in team management and software development life cycle (SDLC).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build strong relationships with stakeholders and team members.
Proficient in project management tools (JIRA, Trello, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
positions.insights: Skills: Web Applications · Leadership · TypeScript · Infrastructure · Git · Microservices · Docker Products · Working Experience

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Admitted to the highly selective and prestigious Honors program, hence eligible to become TA and awarded Tuition scholarship
along with stipend as TA by working under Prof. Marco Papa for CSCI 571 – Web Technologies, Master’s Level course.
● Developing responsive assignments based on HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, Angular 8.0+, NodeJS, GCP, Django etc.
● Holding office hours every week to help students in understanding the technologies listed above and solving doubts around
deploying apps on GCP, coding standards, good practices, Git and other web technologies.

positions.title: Information Technology Technician
positions.description:
Assist in developing long-term strategies and capacity planning for meeting future computer hardware needs.
On-site diagnosis and analysis of complex PC problems for a variety of end users and recommend corrective solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Motivate, manage and contribute to design and development of backend and its API’s to improvise features.
Collaborate with other engineers by working closely in a cross-functional team of 35, for better insights of API development.
Research, advise and implement new solutions to backend services to improve performance of more than 50 existing work.
Design software solutions for new features and enhancing code efficiency without compromising codebase quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Applications · Git · Working Experience

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Built API modules and integrated in codebase to provide an automated wheel alignment system with portability.
Led team to work with configurations of cameras, system setup, camera coordinates and advanced mathematics.
Implemented 3D reconstruction, Epipolar geometry, Camera Calibration, Stereo Correspondence, Image Processing, Geometric 
Image Transformation, Camera Angles, Camera Coordinate System etc. through OpenCV.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Coordinated with team leader and developed a real-time system of Smart Autonomous Weed Detection on Crop Farms
Created system using basic machine learning algorithms and Computer Vision to detect weeds on images and videos.
Integrated python script with Raspberry PI along with IC hardware equipment to experience real-time implementation.

courses.name: Advanced Mobile Devices and Game Consoles

volunteerExperiences.description: Served as Volunteer in Social Campaigns and Donate Blood Campaigns and Worked as Intern in Office.

projects.title: Entertainment Event Search
projects.description:
Developed web application using Angular on frontend, Node js on backend and Bootstrap for Responsive Web Design.
APIs used in project are TicketMaster, Spotify, Twitter, Google Maps and Google Geocode with proper authorization.
Deployed web application on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its error and debugging was carried out on GCP as well. 
Features include auto completion, favourites on localStorage, animations, form validation, user location etc.

projects.title: AI Face Recognition
projects.description:
Implementation of face detection and face recognition in real-time to solve challenges faced by the recent technologies.
Developed using ML and AI to recognize the different faces and the KNN method along with classifiers for recognition of
faces.

publications.title: FM Broadcast Audio Signal Analysis Using Time–Frequency Distribution Function
Generative Adversarial Network (GANs) based training set enhancement for Stomach Adenocarcinoma Computed Tomography (CT) scan
